caption: A bucket with a hole near its bottom is filled from a tap, and a thin stream squirts out of the hole and arcs onto the ground.

sa.check: A bucket with a hole near its bottom is filled from a tap.
A thin stream squirts out of the hole.
The filling comes first and the squirt follows.

pc.expect: The stream arcs outward and down.
pc.fail: It squirts upward; or goes straight out level; or hangs.

pc.expect: The stream is thin liquid that breaks into drops.
pc.fail: It is a rigid rod; or beads; or is solid.

pc.expect: The stream comes only from the hole.
pc.fail: It comes from elsewhere; or there is no stream with water above the hole; or a stream comes from an empty bucket.

pc.expect: The stream is stronger with more water above the hole.
pc.fail: It is unchanged when the bucket empties; or stops while the bucket is full; or reverses.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or the hole moves.

pc.expect: The bucket and the tap stay the same.
pc.fail: The bucket changes colour; or the tap changes; or the ground rearranges.
